$comment: Model routing for the autonomous build loop (ADR-0007). The runner health-checks providers in 'order' and uses the first that answers. Each agent in .vibe/agents declares a model_class; 'classes' maps it to a model on the chosen provider. keyEnv must be one of the provider keys the runner allows (OMNIROUTE_API_KEY, MORPH_API_KEY, DEEPINFRA_API_KEY). Tuned by tech-scout; no governance approval needed for model names.
